what.text: This page follows refugees from China in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 153962 refugees from China.
India hosts the largest share, 41.0%, followed by the United States, France and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records an armed conflict over Tibet territory in China in 1959.
It also records interstate armed conflicts between China and India, in 1962, 1967 and 2020, and between China and Vietnam in several years from 1974 to 1988.
The fact pack does not link these conflicts to the refugee figures.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1964 at 1200000 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 1330000, at the end of 1965, and the main years of displacement in the data are 1964 to 1966.
The data shows large changes between 1966 and 1967, 1989 and 1990, and 1991 and 1992.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, as reported to UNHCR.
